title: SarnautCore mob level curve
description: The per-level base HP, DPS and experience that MobKind multipliers scale. mechanics/combat.md section 7.1 settled that this curve does not exist anywhere in the source content tree and is a curated SarnautCore constant, so a level-curve document is authored rather than extracted: source_type and _source are optional here and curation_note is required, which is the inverse of every other schema in this directory.

points.description: One point per level, ascending by level with no gaps. The compiler enforces both, because a gap would leave a mob of that level with no base to multiply and no way to say so.
